The current logic splits the line at the first `=` and then splits the value at the first `#` to remove comments. This is incorrect because the value itself can contain `=` or `#` characters that are not comments.

I need to modify line 40 to correctly capture the entire value after the first `=`. The value should only be split by `#` if it's intended as a comment, but the problem description implies that `#` and `=` within the value should be preserved. The current implementation splits the value at the first `#` and takes the first part, which is incorrect.

I will modify line 40 to `result[section][key] = parts[1].strip()`. This will take everything after the first `=` as the value and strip whitespace from it. This should resolve the issue of values being cut short.
